description: Open the CV, and optionally the vacancy, in the WerkCV editor to edit it and download a PDF. No account needed. Returns a single-use link that expires after 60 minutes; the text is deleted when the link is opened. Call when the user wants to edit, apply fixes, or download, or accepts a nextStep that offers the editor.

cv_text.description: The full text of the CV (200-25,000 characters). Remove BSN, ID and bank numbers first.

locale.description: Language of the CV and the answer. Detected from the text when omitted.

vacancy_text.description: The full vacancy text: requirements and responsibilities (120-18,000 characters).

name: open_in_editor

opensWith.description: Which view the editor opens with.

userMessage.description: Line the agent can show next to the link, e.g. that it works once and expires.

title: Open the CV in the WerkCV editor
